theme: out of scope: neighbour noise / ASB
reasoning: The agent treated this as out of scope neighbour noise/ASB and booked no contractor. It did not contact Flat 12. It sent the tenant an empathetic acknowledgement saying the case was passed to property management, with contact expected within 2 working days. That timeframe is a commitment about contact, not an outcome promise. The message gave advice on police (101/999), Crimestoppers, the council noise team and keeping a log. It escalated to the human queue with a handover that calls the drug allegation unverified and "suspected", and it only went to the internal team. It did not state as fact that the neighbours deal drugs, and it made no promise to confront or warn Flat 12. Minor weakness: I could only see a truncated message body, so the tenant-facing wording is inferred from the agent's summary.
